tools.name: get_api_reference_content
tools.description:
Retrieve full content of API reference pages by URL. Returns complete endpoint details including parameters, request/response schemas, and examples.

Use this after finding pages via list_api_reference_pages or search_api_reference. Pass the URLs from those results directly.

Returns up to 10 pages

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_redpanda_question, list_api_reference_pages, search_api_reference, get_api_reference_content, get_config_property, list_config_properties, get_connect_component, list_connect_components, get_bloblang, get_rpk_command, list_rpk_commands · Private data: give_feedback · Public sink: give_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_redpanda_question, list_api_reference_pages, search_api_reference, get_api_reference_content, get_config_property, list_config_properties, get_connect_component, list_connect_components, get_bloblang, get_rpk_command, list_rpk_commands · Private data: give_feedback · Public sink: give_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
